prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Tune Your Companion's Personality", "Select traits to customize how your desktop pet reacts, moves, and greets you every day.", "Choose Personality", "Save & Continue"]
1: ["Try Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice calling your pet to your cursor, toggling desktop visibility, and sending text prompts before launching.", "Desktop Pet Simulator", "I'm Ready!"]
2: ["Your Pet's Habitat Is Preparing", "Drag toys around the playground while your desktop pet assets finish downloading."]
3: ["Calibrate Monitor & Taskbar Placement", "Confirm which display screen your pet should roam on and choose its favorite desktop corner.", "Select Primary Monitor", "Confirm Placement"]
4: ["Upload Custom Pet Photos", "Provide clear photos of your pet for accurate 3D model generation.", "Ensure bright daylight and a plain background for accurate pet feature detection.", "Good lighting verified | Pet face visible | Sharp focus"]
5: ["Create Account & Unlock Founder Items", "Sign in to safely save your custom pet and claim the exclusive Golden Collar item pack.", "Exclusive Founder Reward Included"]
6: ["You can minimize this window. We'll alert you via system notification when your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Choose a virtual friend that lives on your screen, reacts to your daily workflow, and keeps you company."]
8: ["Downloading High-Res Textures..."]
9: ["Your Pet Is On Desktop! Press Alt+P to Summon", "Double-click your pet anytime to play, or right-click to send it to the system tray.", "Start Playing"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions exclusive rewards, gifts, or free extras to incentivize signing in.
